name: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
author: Vincent

name: Toymaker
firstNightReminder: The Toymaker is shown a number.
ability: You start knowing the largest group of good players sitting next to each other.

name: Caroler
firstNightReminder: The Caroler is shown a number.
otherNightReminder: The Caroler is shown a number.
ability: Each night, you learn how many players are on the nice list.

name: Shepherd
firstNightReminder: Wake the Shepherd and nod or shake your head
otherNightReminder: Wake the Shepherd and nod or shake your head
ability: Each night, you learn if a player has changed alignment tonight.
flavor: Baaah I am worrying about this later

name: Gift Wrapper
otherNightReminder: The Gift Wrapper chooses a player.
ability: Each night*, choose a player: If they are on the nice list, you learn their alignment.

name: Snow Sweeper
firstNightReminder: The Snow Sweeper is shown one character token
otherNightReminder: The Snow Sweeper is shown one character token
ability: Each night, you learn one character that woke up tonight.

name: Melchior
firstNightReminder: Melchior may choose up to 2 players
otherNightReminder: Melchior may choose up to 2 players
ability: Each night, choose up to 2 players: They are placed on the nice list.

name: Nutcracker
ability: Each night, choose a player: Everyone that votes for them the next day is placed on the nice list.

name: Yuletide Zealot
ability: Each day, you may privately ask the storyteller for a gift. If you are on the nice list, it will be helpful. Otherwise, it might not.
flavor: Some people just take Christmas way to seriously.

name: Gooseherd
ability: If both of your alive neighbors are good, they are on the nice list and cannot die.

name: Jesus
ability: While you are alive, you are always on the nice list. If you are executed, you are resurrected three days later.

name: Redeemer
firstNightReminder: The Redeemer may choose a player
otherNightReminder: The Redeemer may choose a player
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: If they are evil and on the nicelist, they become good. If they are good and on the naughty list, they die.

name: Rapscallion
ability: Once per game, publicly declare you are the Rapscallion. If you are executed and all alive good players are on the naughty list, your team wins.

name: Pessimist
firstNightReminder: If the Pessimist died tonight or yesterday, they may choose a player
otherNightReminder: If the Pessimist died tonight or yesterday, they may choose a player
ability: When you die, choose a player: If they are on the naughty list, they become evil.

name: Judas
ability: The first time you are chosen by a player at night, they die. If the demon dies this way, you become their character and alignment.

name: Grinch
ability: If you are on the naughty list, you are evil. Otherwise, you are good.

name: Scrooge
ability: You might register as evil and as a particular Minion, or as on the naughty list.

name: Elf
otherNightReminder: If the Elf died yesterday, they choose a player
ability: If you died during the day, choose an alive player. They become an Elf.

name: Saint Nicholas
ability: Each night, choose a player: If they are on the naughty list, their votes do not count the next day.

name: Jólaköttur
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a character: If in play, they are poisoned.

name: Rudolph
ability: While you are alive, every player that is not on the nice list is on the naughty list.

name: Krampus
otherNightReminder: Krampus sees which players were chosen by the Demon and chooses one.
ability: Each night*, you learn which players were chosen by the Demon. Choose which one dies.

name: Old Man Winter
ability: Each night, choose two players: If they are both on the naughty list, they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.

name: Santa Clause
ability: Each night, choose three players: One dies, the other two are placed on the naughty list. Players that have been on the naughty list for 3 nights in a row die.

name: Nice List
ability: Keeps track of which players have been good.
flavor: If you find yourself here, good job!

name: Naughty List
ability: Keeps track of which players have been naughty.
flavor: If you find yourself here, that is okay - it is not too late!

name: Naughty List
ability: Keeps track of which players have been really naughty.
flavor: If you find yourself here, good luck...
